Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 25-Nov-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. END SEMESTER DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER / DECEMBER 2024  
  SUBJECT: ICT 2123- DIGITAL SYSTEMS AND COMPUTER ORGANIZATION  
  DIGITAL SYSTEMS AND COMPUTER ORGANIZATION [ICT 2123]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Design a Mealy machine that detects the sequence "1101".                                               (5)  
  a) How many states are required for the Mealy machine to detect the sequence "1101"?  
  b) Construct the state transition table for the Mealy machine.  
  c) Given an input sequence of "1101101", determine the output sequence.  
1B)               Explain the difference between hardwired control units and microprogrammed control units. What         (3)  
  are the advantages and disadvantages of each?  
1C)               Define a MOD-N counter. How does the value of N affect the design of the synchronous counter?          (2)  
2A)               Design a 4-bit Carry Lookahead Adder (CLA) to add two binary numbers A=11012 and B=10112 .             (5)  
  a) Calculate the generate (G) and propagate (P) signals for each bit.  
  b) Determine the carry outputs for each bit.  
  c) Calculate the final sum.  
2B)               Explain the difference between hardwired control units and microprogrammed control units. What         (3)  
  are the advantages and disadvantages of each?  
2C)               Design a D Flip-Flop using SR Latch of Nand gate.                                                      (2)  
3A)               Perform division of (1101)2 by (110)2 using restoring division algorithm, indicating all the steps.    (5)  
  
3B)               Design 2- bit binary adder using 3 to 8 decoders with active high outputs and external gates.          (3)  
3C)               Design 1 - bit magnitude comparator with cascading inputs using NAND gates only.                       (2)  
4A)               Design a 4-bit synchronous counter to count according to the given sequence using D - flip flops       (5)  
  and minimum external gates. All the undefined states should go to state 0.  
  
  
4B)               Using the Johnson counter, generate the sequence 010110. Use JK - flip flops and minimum               (3)  
  external gates for the design.  
4C)               Simplify the Boolean expression into POS and implement using NOR gates.                                (2)  
  $$F(A, B, C, D)=\sum (1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9,10, 14)$$  
5A)               Design a code converter to convert a decimal digit represented in 84-2-1 code to a decimal digit       (5)  
  represented in Excess-3 code using a 3 to 8 decoder with active low output and external gates.  
$$5B)               Realize f1(x,y,z,w) = Σ (0, 2, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 13) using 8:1 multiplexer and basic gates.              (3)$$  
5C)               What is the role of the CPU in programmed I/O, and how does it differ from direct memory access        (2)  
  (DMA)?  
  
  
  -----End-----
